activity.role: Chairman of the Council of Ministers
activity.notes: On 15 March 1946 the Soviet government nomenclature changed from the Council of People's Commissars to the Council of Ministers, with Stalin continuing as chairman. He remained head of government until his death in March 1953. ATLAS records the renamed formal office as a separate phase.

sources.title: Foreign Relations of the United States, 1946, Volume VI — Kennan memorandum
sources.citation_text: The U.S. Department of State historical note identifies Stalin as Chairman of the Council of People's Commissars and, after 15 March 1946, Chairman of the Council of Ministers.

sources.title: Stalin succession memorandum, 1953 — Foreign Relations of the United States
sources.citation_text: The 1953 State Department analysis states that Stalin had held the key government post since 1941 and identifies the Council of Ministers chairmanship as requiring an immediate successor after his death.
